01b04115: ;If the data global variable DG has a defined local variable with a subscript greater than 9, call the ^DIE17 routine and execute the code in the F^DIE17 label. Set the variable Y to the undefined control character, and set DQ to 2. Call the X2 label in the current routine. If Y is undefined or if Y equals the undefined control character, go to the A label. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', and set DW to the value of DQ. Then, go to the OUT^DIE17 label in the ^DIE17 routine.

d464008b: ;If the 'DG' array is defined (i.e., if the variable 'DG' has been assigned a value), and the number of subscripts in the 'DG' array is greater than 9, then execute the 'F^DIE17' subroutine, and the 'DE' subroutine. Set 'Y' to the ASCII unit separator character (^@). Set 'DQ' to 4. Call the 'X4' subroutine. If 'Y' is undefined or equal to the unit separator character, go to the 'A' label. Otherwise, set 'X' to the value of 'Y'. Set 'DIC(0)' to 'F' (which likely indicates that the input is being validated or transformed). Set 'DW' to the value of 'DQ' (which was previously set to 4). Finally, go to the 'OUT^DIE17' subroutine.
